description.value: Pistachio Sweetery Café is a Downtown Vancouver café specializing in traditional Turkish coffee and Middle Eastern sweets, including baklava, kunafa, and pistachio cheesecake made with ingredients sourced from the Middle East and Mediterranean. It positions itself as a cultural crossroads in the heart of the city, blending Turkish coffee tradition with Arabic and Middle Eastern flavours. Indoor seating is available and the café is wheelchair accessible.
